title: World Wrestling C'ships: India script history as Neelam, Kajal settle for silver
content: India’s Kajal Dhochak and Neelam Sirohi created history by winning silver medals at the World Wrestling Championships in Astana, becoming the first Indian women to reach finals at the same edition. Kajal narrowly lost 6-8 to Ukraine’s Anastasiya Alpyeyeva, while Neelam fell to Japan’s Yui Susaki, securing India’s landmark double-silver finish.

title: Microsoft employees in India can now opt for a buyout: Who qualifies and what it pays
content: Microsoft is offering buyouts to around 60,000 employees, over a quarter of its workforce, in India, the US, the UK and Canada. HR head Amy Coleman announced the Voluntary Exit Offer in a memo to staff. The package matches standard severance, which can run up to 39 weeks of pay. Xbox, Copilot and Windows teams are eligible, sales is excluded, and the deadline is December.

title: Indian-American candidates in US midterms: Key races, latest polling & what's at stake
content: From Ro Khanna's re-election bid in Silicon Valley to Vivek Ramaswamy's gubernatorial contest in Ohio, Indian-American politicians are competing in some of the most closely watched congressional, statewide and mayoral electionson November 3.

title: Angelina Jolie's charity helps over 17,000 children secure legal representation
content: Kids in Need of Defense, co-founded by Angelina Jolie in 2008, assists unaccompanied children with legal representation. KIND ensures that these children receive psychosocial support and comprehensive services across the United States and Mexico. The organization has aided over 17,000 children by connecting them with pro bono attorneys who understand their cases. Many of these children have endured significant trauma and require specialized interventions.

title: Molineux mania! UP Warriorz outgun RCB in Rs 1.10 cr showstopper at WPL auction
content: UP Warriorz secured Australia captain Sophie Molineux for Rs 1.10 crore after a bidding battle with RCB at the WPL mini auction in Kochi. They also signed Grace Harris, Sushma Verma and Sneh Rana, prioritising experience. Delhi Capitals bought Kiran Navgire for ₹75 lakh, while Gujarat Giants signed Gunalan Kamalini. Sri Lankan veteran Chamari Athapaththu surprisingly went unsold.

title: Meet Ryan Ragsdale, 11: Sold 700 Pokémon cards, raised $20k for heart research
content: In an inspiring display of generosity, Texas schoolboy Ryan Ragsdale, age 11, has successfully raised over $20,000 for charity through selling his toys and other items. Since the tender age of five, Ryan has organized fundraisers via the American Heart Association’s Kids Heart Challenge, contributing to children battling heart defects. His creative fundraising methods include selling Pokémon cards, unique hand-painted rocks, and a collection of jokes.

title: Meet Quint Pottinger: Driverless tractor helps protect 245-year Kentucky farm
content: Meet Quint Pottinger, an eighth-generation Kentucky farmer turning to autonomous tractors to protect his family’s 245-year-old farm. After three years of drought reduced crop yields to 100-130 bushels per acre, technology is helping the family plant 800 acres of crops and cover crops, offering new hope for the farm’s future while reducing labour demands.

title: Dropbox layoffs: Co-CEO announces 9% job cuts in company memo
content: Dropbox has announced a significant reduction in its workforce, planning to eliminate approximately 9% of its positions as part of a strategic realignment of resources. This move is expected to result in severance expenses ranging from $27 million to $33 million, impacting the company's financials primarily in Q4 of 2026.

title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's gift lets Nashville grocery store resume aid
content: Prior to their wedding at Madison Square Garden, Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce donated $26 million to various charities. One of the notable beneficiaries was The Store, a Nashville non-profit aimed at combating food insecurity. Due to rising food costs, The Store had paused the admission of new families prior to receiving the donation. The couple's charitable efforts supported 20 local and national organizations, reflecting their deep community ties.

title: Cyclone Arnab leaves trail of destruction in Andhra, 8 killed
content: In the wake of severe cyclonic storm Arnab, eight fatalities have been reported across Andhra Pradesh. The cyclone caused extensive damage, uprooting trees and downing power lines, leaving many communities in despair with flooding and blackouts. Chief Minister Nara Chandrababu Naidu has appealed for central government support to manage the disaster's impact, though early evaluations show that certain coconut crops remained relatively unscathed.

title: Stephen Curry celebrates wife Ayesha’s career-first move into holiday movies
content: In an exciting leap in her acting journey, Ayesha Curry is taking on her first leading role in the upcoming feature film 'Second Chance Holiday.' Starring alongside Matthew Daddario, she plays a dating expert in a storyline that promises romance and laughter. Scheduled for streaming on Roku Channel starting November 5, this project highlights Ayesha’s dedication to her craft, with supportive words from Stephen Curry amplifying her achievements.

title: Tyreek Hill to Chiefs gains momentum as WR trade options narrow before deadline
content: The Kansas City Chiefs could consider reuniting with Tyreek Hill as they search for wide receiver help before the NFL trade deadline. Injuries to Rashee Rice and Tyquan Thornton have increased the team's urgency, but trade options remain limited. ESPN insider Adam Schefter confirmed Kansas City has contacted teams about receivers. Hill is nearing the final stages of rehabilitation from a serious knee injury, though his recovery and ability to regain peak form remain concerns.

title: Man clings to moving Thar SUV as traffic cops try to seize vehicle in Gurgaon
content: On a Tuesday evening, traffic police pulled over a black Mahindra Thar for inspection after noticing violations, including the absence of a number plate and heavily tinted windows. The driver was unable to provide any documents, leading to a confrontation as one passenger desperately clung to the driver-side window while the car tried to flee. The police confiscated the Thar and are pursuing further legal measures regarding this incident.

title: 'Diwali gift from PM Modi': Cabinet approves 3% DA increase for central govt employees
content: In a significant move ahead of the Diwali celebrations, the Union Cabinet has approved a 3 percent increase in Dearness Allowance and Dearness Relief for central government employees and pensioners, impacting more than 1.17 crore beneficiaries. Effective from July 1, 2026, this adjustment elevates the DA and DR from 60 to 63 percent of basic pay and pension.

title: Spain train crash: Drone footage captures twisted carriages as toll tops 60
content: The crash occurred along the Madrid-Seville high-speed railway line in Toledo province, where two trains carrying hundreds of passengers were travelling in the same direction towards Seville in southwestern Spain, according to Esther Padilla, spokesperson for the Castilla-La Mancha regional government. Spain's rail infrastructure operator ADIF said the accident took place on Wednesday morning.

title: SC says legality of EC's 'logical discrepancy' checks in SIR remains undecided
content: A bench comprising Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana said its earlier decision allowing the Election Commission to use the category in West Bengal was only an interim measure. It also clarified that the court’s ruling on the SIR exercise in Bihar had not settled every legal question surrounding the revision process.

title: 'Not a concern': 118 runs, no fifty in tri-series but Babar still has Pakistan's backing
content: Pakistan suffered their first defeat of the series on Tuesday, losing to Sri Lanka by eight wickets in Lahore. Babar top-scored for Pakistan with 29, but the team's batting lineup collapsed as they were bowled out for just 110.

title: Disabled flyer stranded 24 hrs at airport without wheelchair, airlines to pay Rs 60k
content: A 65-year-old disabled passenger, Kirpal Singh, faced issues during his air travel from Amritsar to London. Singh did not receive the requested wheelchair assistance at Istanbul airport, leaving him stranded for nearly 24 hours. His checked-in baggage was delayed, causing him to miss a subsequent flight to Toronto after arriving in London. Following his complaints, the consumer commission ordered both airlines to pay compensation for the harassment experienced.

title: Happy Karwa Chauth 2026: Images, wishes, quotes and greeting cards
content: On October 29, 2026, the much-anticipated Karwa Chauth festival will be celebrated, highlighting the deep bond of love as people fast for their partners. This annual event is marked by exchanging warm wishes and quotes, especially toward mothers-in-law and respected seniors, acknowledging their vital role in the festivities. The rituals serve to strengthen community ties and express unwavering devotion.

title: 'Businesses already hate all of you': Rahul's 4-point reply to Sitharaman's advice
content: Rahul Gandhi responded to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman regarding the Tata Group's ongoing dispute. He questioned the motives behind hosting Tata representatives at Amit Shah's residence. The exchange followed Rahul's earlier post accusing the government of "criminally destroying" the Tata Group and questioning business leaders' silence over the matter.

title: Shiv Sena office-bearer killed as speeding SUV hits bike on Mumbai-Goa highway
content: Tragedy struck when Janardan Changya Gowari, a spokesperson for Shiv Sena, lost his life in a road accident on the Mumbai-Goa highway. His motorcycle was tragically hit by a speeding SUV driven by Mahesh Shivdas Hirve at Adghar village phata. The police have taken swift action, booking Hirve for causing Gowari's death and invoking several legal provisions, as CCTV footage from a nearby hotel captured the shocking incident.

title: Spain train crash: Govt blames 'human error' by operator — what led to collision?
content: "A human error by an Adif operator in the face of a breakdown of the main signaling system is the possible cause of the accident," sources from the government led by Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez told Okdiario. The collision involved an AVE train and an Iryo train on the Madrid-Seville route, disrupting rail services connecting Madrid with Ciudad Real and Andalusia.

title: 63 in 100 Indian pilots may be sleepy during dawn landings, safety review warns
content: A new evaluation reveals that approximately 63 out of 100 Indian pilots may be drowsy during dawn landings. This study examined how India's regulations on pilot working hours influence alertness on nighttime flights. It raised concerns about the sufficiency of current guidelines in combating pilot fatigue, with many aviators frequently reporting exhaustion while on duty.

title: Career not ending! 44-yo Anderson to play in Italy after Lancashire exit
content: James Anderson will continue his cricket career in Italy after Lancashire declined to renew his contract. The 44-year-old will captain and co-own a Naples-based team in a 10-over tournament starting November 18. The competition will feature international stars and promote Italian cricket through coaching clinics, supporting the country’s ambitions to develop players for the 2032 Brisbane Olympics.

title: iPad mini price surge: 2026 upgrade costs Rs 82,900; worth it for India buyers?
content: Apple's refresh of the iPad mini brings notable enhancements such as a dazzling OLED display, enhanced performance standards, and water resistance capabilities. However, the steep rise in price to Rs 82,900 has provoked worries regarding its affordability. This latest model is Rs 33,000 pricier than its predecessor, potentially steering the device towards a niche market as consumers weigh the value of these features against the cost.

title: Neeraj Yadav remembered as a friend, motivator and ‘zindadil insaan’
content: Three-time Asian Para Games gold medallist Neeraj Yadav is remembered by fellow para-athletes Navdeep Singh and Suvarna Raj as a friend, elder brother and source of encouragement. From shared training camps and late-night conversations to his efforts to motivate younger athletes, their recollections reveal a man who brought laughter and warmth to their lives. As a police investigation continues into his death, his friends struggle to reconcile their memories with the sudden loss.
